worker.instances: one dedicated Worker per page, created before any case and shared by that page's Worker cases
worker.messaging: Worker.postMessage / DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope.postMessage, one reply per request, sequential
worker.control: a MessageChannel created by the Worker, used only to set up cases outside timing

equivalence: checked after measurement, for the thread of the measured cases
